title: SELISE Blocks project file
description: The contract for blocks.project.yaml / blocks.project.json and their per-environment overlays (blocks.project.<env>.yaml). Decision 0007. A section that is absent is not managed. Unknown keys are an error. Secret values never appear in the file: a secret is written as { secretRef: NAME }.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

schemaVersion.description: File format version. This CLI knows version 1 and refuses a newer one.

tenantId.description: The project (tenant) the file describes. May be "${env:NAME}". Omitted: the workspace's own project (blocks.json, or --project).

name.description: A label for people; not sent to the server.

data.description: Data Gateway schemas and access rules. Paths are relative to the base project file. Omitted keys fall back to blocks.json (data.schemas, data.rules) and then to blocks/data/schemas and blocks/data/rules.json.

schemas.description: Folder of schema files, one per schema, as 'blocks data schema pull' writes them.

rules.description: Rules file, as 'blocks data rules pull' writes it.

newSchemaAccess.description: Access a newly created schema gets (same meaning as 'data sync --access').

secrets.description: Names of Blocks Secrets that must exist. Values are never in this file.

secretName.description: A Blocks Secrets name, as 'blocks secrets list' shows it.

secretRef.description: A reference to a Blocks Secret. Resolved in memory when a value is needed, never stored or printed.

reservedArea.description: An area 'blocks plan' does not compare yet (0007 build steps 3 and 4 define its keys). It is still checked for literal secrets.
